title: Lantern-Lipped Lollopfish
statement: A plump, velvet-blue fish that lollops through a tank of dusky teal water, with a small glowing lantern on its lower lip that it dims whenever it gets shy. It spends its evenings arranging pebbles into tidy little spirals among the sea-glass ferns, then drifts back to admire its work and hums in bubbles of soft gold.
